),

WITH "driver_latest_races" AS (
  SELECT
    "r"."year",
    MAX("ds"."race_id") AS "race_id"
  FROM "F1"."F1"."DRIVER_STANDINGS" AS "ds"
  JOIN "F1"."F1"."RACES" AS "r"
    ON "ds"."race_id" = "r"."race_id"
  GROUP BY
    "r"."year"
),
"driver_ranked" AS (
  SELECT
    "dlr"."year",
    "ds"."driver_id",
    COALESCE("d"."full_name", TRIM(COALESCE("d"."forename", '') || ' ' || COALESCE("d"."surname", ''))) AS "driver_full_name",
    "ds"."points" AS "driver_points",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY "dlr"."year"
      ORDER BY "ds"."points" DESC NULLS LAST, "ds"."position" ASC NULLS LAST, "ds"."driver_id" ASC
    ) AS "driver_rank"
  FROM "driver_latest_races" AS "dlr"
  JOIN "F1"."F1"."DRIVER_STANDINGS" AS "ds"
    ON "dlr"."race_id" = "ds"."race_id"
  JOIN "F1"."F1"."DRIVERS" AS "d"
    ON "ds"."driver_id" = "d"."driver_id"
),
"constructor_latest_races" AS (
  SELECT
    "r"."year",
    MAX("cs"."race_id") AS "race_id"
  FROM "F1"."F1"."CONSTRUCTOR_STANDINGS" AS "cs"
  JOIN "F1"."F1"."RACES" AS "r"
    ON "cs"."race_id" = "r"."race_id"
  GROUP BY
    "r"."year"
),
"official_constructor_points" AS (
  SELECT
    "clr"."year",
    "cs"."constructor_id",
    "cs"."points" AS "constructor_points",
    "cs"."position" AS "constructor_position"
  FROM "constructor_latest_races" AS "clr"
  JOIN "F1"."F1"."CONSTRUCTOR_STANDINGS" AS "cs"
    ON "clr"."race_id" = "cs"."race_id"
),
"fallback_constructor_points" AS (
  SELECT
    "r"."year",
    "res"."constructor_id",
    SUM(COALESCE("res"."points", 0)) AS "constructor_points",
    NULL AS "constructor_position"
  FROM "F1"."F1"."RESULTS" AS "res"
  JOIN "F1"."F1"."RACES" AS "r"
    ON "res"."race_id" = "r"."race_id"
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1
    FROM "official_constructor_points" AS "ocp"
    WHERE "ocp"."year" = "r"."year"
  )
  GROUP BY
    "r"."year",
    "res"."constructor_id"
),
"constructor_points" AS (
  SELECT
    "year",
    "constructor_id",
    "constructor_points",
    "constructor_position"
  FROM "official_constructor_points"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "year",
    "constructor_id",
    "constructor_points",
    "constructor_position"
  FROM "fallback_constructor_points"
),
"constructor_ranked" AS (
  SELECT
    "cp"."year",
    "cp"."constructor_id",
    "c"."name" AS "constructor_name",
    "cp"."constructor_points",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY "cp"."year"
      ORDER BY "cp"."constructor_points" DESC NULLS LAST, "cp"."constructor_position" ASC NULLS LAST, "cp"."constructor_id" ASC
    ) AS "constructor_rank"
  FROM "constructor_points" AS "cp"
  JOIN "F1"."F1"."CONSTRUCTORS" AS "c"
    ON "cp"."constructor_id" = "c"."constructor_id"
)
SELECT
  "dr"."year",
  "dr"."driver_id",
  "dr"."driver_full_name",
  "dr"."driver_points",
  "cr"."constructor_id",
  "cr"."constructor_name",
  "cr"."constructor_points"
FROM "driver_ranked" AS "dr"
JOIN "constructor_ranked" AS "cr"
  ON "dr"."year" = "cr"."year"
WHERE "dr"."driver_rank" = 1
  AND "cr"."constructor_rank" = 1
ORDER BY
  "dr"."year" DESC;

"driver_year_points" AS (
    SELECT
        "dp"."year" AS "year",
        "dp"."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
        SUM("dp"."points") AS "total_driver_points"
    FROM "driver_points" AS "dp"
    GROUP BY
        "dp"."year",
        "dp"."driver_id"
),
"top_drivers" AS (
    SELECT
        "dyp"."year" AS "year",
        "dyp"."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
        COALESCE("d"."full_name", "d"."forename" || ' ' || "d"."surname") AS "driver_full_name",
        "dyp"."total_driver_points" AS "total_driver_points"
    FROM "driver_year_points" AS "dyp"
    JOIN "F1"."F1"."DRIVERS" AS "d"
        ON "d"."driver_id" = "dyp"."driver_id"
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY "dyp"."year"
        ORDER BY "dyp"."total_driver_points" DESC NULLS LAST, "driver_full_name" ASC NULLS LAST, "dyp"."driver_id" ASC NULLS LAST
    ) = 1
),
"constructor_points" AS (
    SELECT
        "r"."year" AS "year",
        "res"."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
        SUM(COALESCE("res"."points", 0)) AS "points"
    FROM "F1"."F1"."RESULTS" AS "res"
    JOIN "F1"."F1"."RACES" AS "r"
        ON "r"."race_id" = "res"."race_id"
    GROUP BY
        "r"."year",
        "res"."constructor_id"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        "r"."year" AS "year",
        "sr"."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
        SUM(COALESCE("sr"."points", 0)) AS "points"
    FROM "F1"."F1"."SPRINT_RESULTS" AS "sr"
    JOIN "F1"."F1"."RACES" AS "r"
        ON "r"."race_id" = "sr"."race_id"
    GROUP BY
        "r"."year",
        "sr"."constructor_id"
),
"constructor_year_points" AS (
    SELECT
        "cp"."year" AS "year",
        "cp"."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
        SUM("cp"."points") AS "total_constructor_points"
    FROM "constructor_points" AS "cp"
    GROUP BY
        "cp"."year",
        "cp"."constructor_id"
),
"top_constructors" AS (
    SELECT
        "cyp"."year" AS "year",
        "cyp"."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
        "c"."name" AS "constructor_name",
        "cyp"."total_constructor_points" AS "total_constructor_points"
    FROM "constructor_year_points" AS "cyp"
    JOIN "F1"."F1"."CONSTRUCTORS" AS "c"
        ON "c"."constructor_id" = "cyp"."constructor_id"
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY "cyp"."year"
        ORDER BY "cyp"."total_constructor_points" DESC NULLS LAST, "c"."name" ASC NULLS LAST, "cyp"."constructor_id" ASC NULLS LAST
    ) = 1
)
SELECT
    "td"."year" AS "year",
    "td"."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
    "td"."driver_full_name" AS "driver_full_name",
    ROUND("td"."total_driver_points", 4) AS "driver_points",
    "tc"."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
    "tc"."constructor_name" AS "constructor_name",
    ROUND("tc"."total_constructor_points", 4) AS "constructor_points"
FROM "top_drivers" AS "td"
LEFT JOIN "top_constructors" AS "tc"
    ON "tc"."year" = "td"."year"
ORDER BY
    "td"."year" DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH "scoring_events" AS (
    SELECT
        "r"."year" AS "year",
        "res"."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
        "res"."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
        COALESCE("res"."points", 0) AS "points"
    FROM F1.F1.RESULTS AS "res"
    JOIN F1.F1.RACES AS "r"
        ON "res"."race_id" = "r"."race_id"

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        "r"."year" AS "year",
        "sr"."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
        "sr"."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
        COALESCE("sr"."points", 0) AS "points"
    FROM F1.F1.SPRINT_RESULTS AS "sr"
    JOIN F1.F1.RACES AS "r"
        ON "sr"."race_id" = "r"."race_id"
),
"driver_points" AS (
    SELECT
        "se"."year" AS "year",
        "se"."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
        SUM("se"."points") AS "driver_points"
    FROM "scoring_events" AS "se"
    GROUP BY
        "se"."year",
        "se"."driver_id"
),
"top_drivers" AS (
    SELECT
        "dp"."year" AS "year",
        "dp"."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
        COALESCE("d"."full_name", "d"."forename" || ' ' || "d"."surname") AS "driver_full_name",
        "dp"."driver_points" AS "driver_points",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY "dp"."year"
            ORDER BY
                "dp"."driver_points" DESC,
                COALESCE("d"."full_name", "d"."forename" || ' ' || "d"."surname") ASC,
                "dp"."driver_id" ASC
        ) AS "rn"
    FROM "driver_points" AS "dp"
    JOIN F1.F1.DRIVERS AS "d"
        ON "dp"."driver_id" = "d"."driver_id"
),
"constructor_points" AS (
    SELECT
        "se"."year" AS "year",
        "se"."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
        SUM("se"."points") AS "constructor_points"
    FROM "scoring_events" AS "se"
    GROUP BY
        "se"."year",
        "se"."constructor_id"
),
"top_constructors" AS (
    SELECT
        "cp"."year" AS "year",
        "cp"."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
        "c"."name" AS "constructor_name",
        "cp"."constructor_points" AS "constructor_points",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY "cp"."year"
            ORDER BY
                "cp"."constructor_points" DESC,
                "c"."name" ASC,
                "cp"."constructor_id" ASC
        ) AS "rn"
    FROM "constructor_points" AS "cp"
    JOIN F1.F1.CONSTRUCTORS AS "c"
        ON "cp"."constructor_id" = "c"."constructor_id"
)
SELECT
    "s"."year" AS "year",
    "td"."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
    "td"."driver_full_name" AS "driver_full_name",
    "td"."driver_points" AS "driver_points",
    "tc"."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
    "tc"."constructor_name" AS "constructor_name",
    "tc"."constructor_points" AS "constructor_points"
FROM F1.F1.SEASONS AS "s"
LEFT JOIN "top_drivers" AS "td"
    ON "s"."year" = "td"."year"
    AND "td"."rn" = 1
LEFT JOIN "top_constructors" AS "tc"
    ON "s"."year" = "tc"."year"
    AND "tc"."rn" = 1
ORDER BY
    "s"."year" ASC;

WITH "season_final_races" AS (
    SELECT
        "r"."year",
        MAX("r"."race_id") AS "race_id"
    FROM F1.F1.RACES AS "r"
    GROUP BY
        "r"."year"
),
"driver_points" AS (
    SELECT
        "sfr"."year",
        "ds"."driver_id",
        "ds"."points" AS "total_points"
    FROM "season_final_races" AS "sfr"
    INNER JOIN F1.F1.DRIVER_STANDINGS AS "ds"
        ON "sfr"."race_id" = "ds"."race_id"
),
"driver_ranked" AS (
    SELECT
        "dp"."year",
        "dp"."driver_id",
        "d"."full_name" AS "driver_full_name",
        "dp"."total_points",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY "dp"."year"
            ORDER BY "dp"."total_points" DESC NULLS LAST, "d"."full_name" ASC NULLS LAST, "dp"."driver_id" ASC NULLS LAST
        ) AS "driver_rank"
    FROM "driver_points" AS "dp"
    INNER JOIN F1.F1.DRIVERS AS "d"
        ON "dp"."driver_id" = "d"."driver_id"
),
"constructor_standings_points" AS (
    SELECT
        "sfr"."year",
        "cs"."constructor_id",
        "cs"."points" AS "total_points"
    FROM "season_final_races" AS "sfr"
    INNER JOIN F1.F1.CONSTRUCTOR_STANDINGS AS "cs"
        ON "sfr"."race_id" = "cs"."race_id"
),
"constructor_result_points" AS (
    SELECT
        "r"."year",
        "res"."constructor_id",
        SUM(COALESCE("res"."points", 0)) AS "total_points"
    FROM F1.F1.RESULTS AS "res"
    INNER JOIN F1.F1.RACES AS "r"
        ON "res"."race_id" = "r"."race_id"
    GROUP BY
        "r"."year",
        "res"."constructor_id"
),
"constructor_points" AS (
    SELECT
        "csp"."year",
        "csp"."constructor_id",
        "csp"."total_points"
    FROM "constructor_standings_points" AS "csp"

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        "crp"."year",
        "crp"."constructor_id",
        "crp"."total_points"
    FROM "constructor_result_points" AS "crp"
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT
            1
        FROM "constructor_standings_points" AS "csp"
        WHERE "csp"."year" = "crp"."year"
    )
),
"constructor_ranked" AS (
    SELECT
        "cp"."year",
        "cp"."constructor_id",
        "c"."name" AS "constructor_name",
        "cp"."total_points",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY "cp"."year"
            ORDER BY "cp"."total_points" DESC NULLS LAST, "c"."name" ASC NULLS LAST, "cp"."constructor_id" ASC NULLS LAST
        ) AS "constructor_rank"
    FROM "constructor_points" AS "cp"
    INNER JOIN F1.F1.CONSTRUCTORS AS "c"
        ON "cp"."constructor_id" = "c"."constructor_id"
)
SELECT
    "s"."year",
    "dr"."driver_id",
    "dr"."driver_full_name",
    ROUND("dr"."total_points", 4) AS "driver_points",
    "cr"."constructor_id",
    "cr"."constructor_name",
    ROUND("cr"."total_points", 4) AS "constructor_points"
FROM F1.F1.SEASONS AS "s"
LEFT JOIN "driver_ranked" AS "dr"
    ON "s"."year" = "dr"."year"
    AND "dr"."driver_rank" = 1
LEFT JOIN "constructor_ranked" AS "cr"
    ON "s"."year" = "cr"."year"
    AND "cr"."constructor_rank" = 1
WHERE "dr"."driver_id" IS NOT NULL
   OR "cr"."constructor_id" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    "s"."year" ASC NULLS LAST;

WITH "scoring_events" AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', TO_DATE(CAST(r."year" AS VARCHAR) || '-01-01')) AS "year_date",
        res."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
        res."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
        COALESCE(res."points", 0) AS "points"
    FROM F1.F1.RESULTS res
    JOIN F1.F1.RACES r
        ON res."race_id" = r."race_id"

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', TO_DATE(CAST(r."year" AS VARCHAR) || '-01-01')) AS "year_date",
        sr."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
        sr."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
        COALESCE(sr."points", 0) AS "points"
    FROM F1.F1.SPRINT_RESULTS sr
    JOIN F1.F1.RACES r
        ON sr."race_id" = r."race_id"
),
"driver_totals" AS (
    SELECT
        "year_date",
        "driver_id",
        SUM("points") AS "driver_points"
    FROM "scoring_events"
    GROUP BY
        "year_date",
        "driver_id"
),
"driver_ranked" AS (
    SELECT
        dt."year_date",
        dt."driver_id",
        d."full_name" AS "driver_full_name",
        dt."driver_points",
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY dt."year_date"
            ORDER BY dt."driver_points" DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS "driver_rank"
    FROM "driver_totals" dt
    JOIN F1.F1.DRIVERS d
        ON dt."driver_id" = d."driver_id"
),
"top_drivers" AS (
    SELECT
        "year_date",
        NULLIF(LISTAGG("driver_full_name", ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "driver_full_name", "driver_id"), '') AS "driver_full_names",
        MAX("driver_points") AS "driver_points"
    FROM "driver_ranked"
    WHERE "driver_rank" = 1
    GROUP BY "year_date"
),
"constructor_totals" AS (
    SELECT
        "year_date",
        "constructor_id",
        SUM("points") AS "constructor_points"
    FROM "scoring_events"
    GROUP BY
        "year_date",
        "constructor_id"
),
"constructor_ranked" AS (
    SELECT
        ct."year_date",
        ct."constructor_id",
        c."name" AS "constructor_name",
        ct."constructor_points",
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ct."year_date"
            ORDER BY ct."constructor_points" DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS "constructor_rank"
    FROM "constructor_totals" ct
    JOIN F1.F1.CONSTRUCTORS c
        ON ct."constructor_id" = c."constructor_id"
),
"top_constructors" AS (
    SELECT
        "year_date",
        NULLIF(LISTAGG("constructor_name", ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "constructor_name", "constructor_id"), '') AS "constructor_names",
        MAX("constructor_points") AS "constructor_points"
    FROM "constructor_ranked"
    WHERE "constructor_rank" = 1
    GROUP BY "year_date"
)
SELECT
    YEAR(td."year_date") AS "year",
    td."driver_full_names" AS "driver_full_names",
    td."driver_points" AS "driver_points",
    tc."constructor_names" AS "constructor_names",
    tc."constructor_points" AS "constructor_points"
FROM "top_drivers" td
JOIN "top_constructors" tc
    ON td."year_date" = tc."year_date"
ORDER BY "year" DESC;

WITH "race_points" AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', TO_DATE(ra."year"::VARCHAR || '-01-01')) AS "year_date",
        re."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
        re."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
        COALESCE(re."points", 0) AS "points"
    FROM F1.F1.RESULTS re
    INNER JOIN F1.F1.RACES ra
        ON re."race_id" = ra."race_id"
),
"driver_year_points" AS (
    SELECT
        "year_date",
        "driver_id",
        SUM("points") AS "total_points"
    FROM "race_points"
    GROUP BY
        "year_date",
        "driver_id"
),
"top_drivers" AS (
    SELECT
        "year_date",
        "driver_id",
        "total_points",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY "year_date"
            ORDER BY "total_points" DESC NULLS LAST, "driver_id" ASC
        ) AS "driver_rank"
    FROM "driver_year_points"
    QUALIFY "driver_rank" = 1
),
"constructor_year_points" AS (
    SELECT
        "year_date",
        "constructor_id",
        SUM("points") AS "total_points"
    FROM "race_points"
    GROUP BY
        "year_date",
        "constructor_id"
),
"top_constructors" AS (
    SELECT
        "year_date",
        "constructor_id",
        "total_points",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY "year_date"
            ORDER BY "total_points" DESC NULLS LAST, "constructor_id" ASC
        ) AS "constructor_rank"
    FROM "constructor_year_points"
    QUALIFY "constructor_rank" = 1
)
SELECT
    YEAR(td."year_date") AS "year",
    td."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
    d."full_name" AS "driver_full_name",
    ROUND(td."total_points", 4) AS "driver_total_points",
    tc."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
    c."name" AS "constructor_name",
    ROUND(tc."total_points", 4) AS "constructor_total_points"
FROM "top_drivers" td
INNER JOIN F1.F1.DRIVERS d
    ON td."driver_id" = d."driver_id"
INNER JOIN "top_constructors" tc
    ON td."year_date" = tc."year_date"
INNER JOIN F1.F1.CONSTRUCTORS c
    ON tc."constructor_id" = c."constructor_id"
ORDER BY
    "year" ASC;

WITH "driver_final_races" AS (
  SELECT
    "r"."year" AS "year",
    MAX("ds"."race_id") AS "race_id"
  FROM F1.F1.DRIVER_STANDINGS AS "ds"
  JOIN F1.F1.RACES AS "r"
    ON "ds"."race_id" = "r"."race_id"
  GROUP BY
    "r"."year"
),
"driver_season_points" AS (
  SELECT
    "dfr"."year" AS "year",
    "ds"."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
    COALESCE("ds"."points", 0) AS "total_points"
  FROM "driver_final_races" AS "dfr"
  JOIN F1.F1.DRIVER_STANDINGS AS "ds"
    ON "dfr"."race_id" = "ds"."race_id"
),
"top_drivers" AS (
  SELECT
    "dsp"."year" AS "year",
    "dsp"."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
    "d"."full_name" AS "driver_full_name",
    "dsp"."total_points" AS "driver_total_points",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY "dsp"."year"
      ORDER BY "dsp"."total_points" DESC NULLS LAST, "d"."full_name" ASC, "dsp"."driver_id" ASC
    ) AS "driver_rank"
  FROM "driver_season_points" AS "dsp"
  JOIN F1.F1.DRIVERS AS "d"
    ON "dsp"."driver_id" = "d"."driver_id"
),
"constructor_final_races" AS (
  SELECT
    "r"."year" AS "year",
    MAX("cs"."race_id") AS "race_id"
  FROM F1.F1.CONSTRUCTOR_STANDINGS AS "cs"
  JOIN F1.F1.RACES AS "r"
    ON "cs"."race_id" = "r"."race_id"
  WHERE "r"."year" >= 1958
  GROUP BY
    "r"."year"
),
"post_1957_constructor_points" AS (
  SELECT
    "cfr"."year" AS "year",
    "cs"."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
    COALESCE("cs"."points", 0) AS "total_points"
  FROM "constructor_final_races" AS "cfr"
  JOIN F1.F1.CONSTRUCTOR_STANDINGS AS "cs"
    ON "cfr"."race_id" = "cs"."race_id"
),
"pre_1958_constructor_points" AS (
  SELECT
    "r"."year" AS "year",
    "res"."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
    SUM(COALESCE("res"."points", 0)) AS "total_points"
  FROM F1.F1.RESULTS AS "res"
  JOIN F1.F1.RACES AS "r"
    ON "res"."race_id" = "r"."race_id"
  WHERE "r"."year" < 1958
  GROUP BY
    "r"."year",
    "res"."constructor_id"
),
"constructor_season_points" AS (
  SELECT
    "year",
    "constructor_id",
    "total_points"
  FROM "pre_1958_constructor_points"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "year",
    "constructor_id",
    "total_points"
  FROM "post_1957_constructor_points"
),
"top_constructors" AS (
  SELECT
    "csp"."year" AS "year",
    "csp"."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
    "c"."name" AS "constructor_name",
    "csp"."total_points" AS "constructor_total_points",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY "csp"."year"
      ORDER BY "csp"."total_points" DESC NULLS LAST, "c"."name" ASC, "csp"."constructor_id" ASC
    ) AS "constructor_rank"
  FROM "constructor_season_points" AS "csp"
  JOIN F1.F1.CONSTRUCTORS AS "c"
    ON "csp"."constructor_id" = "c"."constructor_id"
)
SELECT
  "td"."year" AS "year",
  "td"."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
  "td"."driver_full_name" AS "driver_full_name",
  ROUND("td"."driver_total_points", 4) AS "driver_total_points",
  "tc"."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
  "tc"."constructor_name" AS "constructor_name",
  ROUND("tc"."constructor_total_points", 4) AS "constructor_total_points"
FROM "top_drivers" AS "td"
JOIN "top_constructors" AS "tc"
  ON "td"."year" = "tc"."year"
WHERE "td"."driver_rank" = 1
  AND "tc"."constructor_rank" = 1
ORDER BY
  "td"."year" DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH "race_years" AS (
    SELECT
        "race_id",
        "year"
    FROM F1.F1.RACES
    UNION
    SELECT
        "race_id",
        "year"
    FROM F1.F1.RACES_EXT
),
"driver_points" AS (
    SELECT
        ry."year" AS "year",
        r."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
        SUM(COALESCE(r."points", 0)) AS "driver_points"
    FROM "race_years" ry
    JOIN F1.F1.RESULTS r
        ON r."race_id" = ry."race_id"
    GROUP BY
        ry."year",
        r."driver_id"
),
"driver_winners" AS (
    SELECT
        dp."year" AS "year",
        dp."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
        d."full_name" AS "driver_full_name",
        dp."driver_points" AS "driver_points"
    FROM "driver_points" dp
    JOIN F1.F1.DRIVERS d
        ON d."driver_id" = dp."driver_id"
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY dp."year"
        ORDER BY dp."driver_points" DESC NULLS LAST, dp."driver_id" ASC
    ) = 1
),
"constructor_points" AS (
    SELECT
        ry."year" AS "year",
        r."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
        SUM(COALESCE(r."points", 0)) AS "constructor_points"
    FROM "race_years" ry
    JOIN F1.F1.RESULTS r
        ON r."race_id" = ry."race_id"
    GROUP BY
        ry."year",
        r."constructor_id"
),
"constructor_winners" AS (
    SELECT
        cp."year" AS "year",
        cp."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
        c."name" AS "constructor_name",
        cp."constructor_points" AS "constructor_points"
    FROM "constructor_points" cp
    JOIN F1.F1.CONSTRUCTORS c
        ON c."constructor_id" = cp."constructor_id"
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY cp."year"
        ORDER BY cp."constructor_points" DESC NULLS LAST, cp."constructor_id" ASC
    ) = 1
)
SELECT
    dw."year" AS "year",
    dw."driver_id" AS "driver_id",
    dw."driver_full_name" AS "driver_full_name",
    ROUND(dw."driver_points", 4) AS "driver_points",
    cw."constructor_id" AS "constructor_id",
    cw."constructor_name" AS "constructor_name",
    ROUND(cw."constructor_points", 4) AS "constructor_points"
FROM "driver_winners" dw
JOIN "constructor_winners" cw
    ON cw."year" = dw."year"
ORDER BY
    dw."year" DESC NULLS LAST;
